name: Put It in Order
why_it_works: Sorting four shuffled steps is a small puzzle with one right answer, and most people are sure they know it. Committing four letters in the comments makes them care about the reveal, and when the order surprises them, the professional who knows it cold earns trust without selling.

hook.pattern: Name a stressful moment and dare the viewer to put four shuffled steps in the right order.
examples: Four steps. One right order. Most people miss it.
Sort these four before the answer shows.

variables.name: scenario
variables.description: The stressful moment, a short sentence starting with a capital, 6 words or fewer
variables.example: You just chipped a front tooth

variables.name: step_1
variables.description: The step that truly comes first, starting with a capital, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: step_2
variables.description: The second step, starting with a capital, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: step_3
variables.description: The third step, starting with a capital, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: step_4
variables.description: The last step, starting with a capital, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: surprise_step
variables.description: The step most people put in the wrong place, as a short sentence starting with a capital, 8 words or fewer
variables.example: Saving the piece comes before the call

variables.name: order_reason
variables.description: One or two plain sentences on why the order matters
variables.example: A saved piece can sometimes be bonded back, so it goes first. Rinsing clears debris, cold limits swelling, then you call.

variables.name: consult_offer
variables.description: Low-pressure next step, starting with a capital, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: disclosure
variables.description: Required fine print for the client's niche, from compliance/packs.json
variables.example: Results vary. Consult a licensed provider.

beats.purpose: hook: the moment and the dare

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 clean desk at {{brand}} with four lettered index cards A B C D shuffled face-up, soft window light, no people

beats.on_screen_text: Comment your order, like C A D B.

beats.voiceover: The right order is B, D, A, C.

visual.prompt: Top-down vertical 9:16 hands sliding four lettered index cards into a row on the {{brand}} desk, B then D then A then C, soft window light

slides.headline: Put these in order
slides.body: {{scenario}}. Comment four letters before you swipe.
slides.visual_prompt: Four lettered index cards shuffled on a clean desk at {{brand}}, soft window light, 4:5

slides.headline: Cards A and B
slides.visual_prompt: Two index cards lettered A and B in {{brand}} colors on the desk

slides.headline: Cards C and D
slides.visual_prompt: Two index cards lettered C and D in {{brand}} colors on the desk

slides.headline: The order: B, D, A, C
slides.visual_prompt: Four index cards in a neat row B D A C with a green check above

slides.headline: Why this order
slides.visual_prompt: Simple numbered flow diagram with four boxes and arrows in {{brand}} colors

slides.headline: Save this checklist
slides.visual_prompt: Clean printable checklist card with four numbered lines and tick boxes

slides.headline: Your situation is different
slides.visual_prompt: {{brand}} logo card with the offer in large type over a calm office photo

craft.notes: The cards are always shown in the same fixed shuffle (step 3, 1, 4, 2) so the answer is always B, D, A, C and the copy never breaks. Put the step people rush to (usually the phone call) somewhere it looks like it should come first.

do_not: Use a sequence the pros themselves argue about
Shame people who got the order wrong in replies
Answer individual cases in the comments; move them to a private consult
compliance: Dental and veterinary: general first-aid information only, no diagnosis or guaranteed results; say to seek care promptly
Law firms: general information, not legal advice; label as attorney advertising where your state bar requires it
Insurance: never imply a claim will be paid; follow policy terms and show license number where required
